from bisect import bisect_right

def erase_overlap_intervals(intervals):
    intervals.sort(key=lambda iv: iv[1])
    ends = [e for _, e in intervals]
    keep = [0] * (len(intervals) + 1)      # keep[i] = most kept among the first i
    for i, (start, end) in enumerate(intervals):
        j = bisect_right(ends, start, 0, i)   # intervals ending ≤ start fit before it
        keep[i + 1] = max(keep[i], keep[j] + 1)
    return len(intervals) - keep[-1]

def find_min_arrow_shots(points):
    points.sort(key=lambda p: p[1])
    arrows, arrow = 0, float('-inf')
    for start, end in points:
        if start > arrow:              # true miss: fire at this balloon's end
            arrows += 1
            arrow = end
    return arrows

def min_meeting_rooms(intervals):
    best = 0
    for t, _ in intervals:             # the peak always starts with some meeting
        busy = sum(s <= t < e for s, e in intervals)
        best = max(best, busy)
    return best
